## SmartBeam beta 1.3.12

### Power and charging

- Start in charging-only mode when USB powers on the device, with the laser and Bluetooth disabled.
- Wake from charging-only mode with a fresh button press; software and OTA restarts remain active with USB attached.
- Keep button handling responsive during shutdown by stopping Bluetooth and saving device logs in a background worker.
- Prevent Bluetooth advertising from restarting after shutdown begins.
- Require release of the shutdown button before accepting a new wake gesture.
- Read USB and charger status directly, independently of battery-voltage sampling, and report charging only while USB is present.
- Keep USB insertion during shutdown in charging-only mode and release power on unplug.

### Validation

- Firmware build and battery, advertising, and shutdown host checks passed.
- Physical USB/button timing and laser behavior still require bench verification.
